title: Huntmaster Draeven
group: The Hour of the Last Eclipse
summary: Control the risen shades and defeat them before the eclipse renews them.
overview: Huntmaster Draeven stalks the Ravine and Crypt. He repeatedly raises shades, turning the encounter into a fight for control of accumulating adds.

roles.label: Tanks
tips: Pick up new shades promptly and keep the battle near Draeven's home.
Watch for renewed shades returning at full strength if older adds survive too long.

roles.label: Healers
tips: Expect pressure to rise when shades spawn and when surviving shades renew.
Stay on the battle's floor and inside the boundary so healing is accepted.

roles.label: Damage dealers
tips: Assign damage to shades before their one-minute renewal.
Use the fifteen-second warning to finish older shades before they return at full strength.

phases.label: Break the Hunt Seal
phases.description: Draeven attempts to summon two shades, up to four living shades at a time. Shades that survive for one minute are replaced by renewed shades.

abilities.name: Risen Shades
abilities.summary: Defeat the adds before their one-minute renewal.
description: Draeven summons two shades every 30 seconds while fewer than four are alive. They enter the battle against eligible raiders.
At 45 seconds of age, a warning announces that the oldest shades have fifteen seconds remaining. At one minute, surviving shades dissolve and are replaced at full strength.

sections.title: Stay in the battle
paragraphs: Fight near the boss's home. Raiders and their pets must remain within 180 paces of the boss and within 30 paces vertically; attacks and aid from outside that boundary are rejected.
If no eligible living raider remains in the arena, or the boss is pulled too far from home, a warning precedes an encounter reset. Keep healers and resurrection targets inside the battle.

sections.title: Control the hunt
paragraphs: Use the oldest-shade warning to set priorities. Leaving an almost defeated shade alive through its renewal loses the damage already dealt.

sections.title: Seasonal victory
paragraphs: A confirmed seasonal kill announces the guild or character victory, identifying the regular or Bloodbound covenant. Pet kills credit their player owner. In-game announcements use the Event Messages chat filter.

loot.title: Equipment
loot.description: One item is selected from this six-item pool.

loot.title: Guardian relic
loot.description: Two copies accompany the equipment reward.
